validation_gates.reason: The path filter starts this workflow for any genrec-source-probe-envelope-* or genrec-source-and-trust-projection-profiles-* receipt, but the receipt step validated only the receipts it named, so a later successor added without updating the step would pass unchecked (review finding on #5294), and a textual coverage check could be satisfied by a mere mention of the path (review finding on #5295). The step validates every receipt from a single list of receipt and ref pairs ("current" validates the working tree) and then fails when any receipt matching the workflow's path globs is missing from that list, so listing a receipt is what validates it: an unlisted successor, even one mentioned in a comment, exits 1 with an ::error:: line, and a stale listed receipt fails with ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH. genrec-source-probe-envelope-receipt-binding-20261019 is pinned to 8c4b8da938798f00bdf503f9819530df7a8a64e0, the merge of #5294.

The step passes as written with all four listed receipts; both fixture replays and the focused tests pass. make repository-guardrails PASS, including workflow security; tests/ci, the receipt-validator tests and the guardrail attribution tests pass.

validation_gates.gate: Hosted CI on the pushed head

notes: Earlier receipts are unchanged and each is validated at the commit where its bytes were recorded. A later change to the workflow, validator or test adds a successor receipt, repoints this entry from current to the commit that merges it, and adds the successor as current; the coverage check fails the job until it does.
